senses.gloss: f. (Ἰουδαική, sub. συναγωγή or ἀγωρά) Jewish court-house.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 1:1:4">Y. Gitt. I, 43ᵇ</cite> top <he>במקום י׳</he> in the Jewish meeting place (where Jews have their own jurisdiction); <he>אם אין שם י׳ וכ׳</he> if there is no Jewish courthouse there, it must be done in the synagogue.
